setup.zh: 翻过秦岭，出了斜谷，是渭水——可渭水没有水。河床裂成一块一块，泾水那边也是干的。旱了三年，分不出哪条清，哪条浊。
setup.en: Over the Qinling and out of the Xie valley lies the Wei — but the Wei has no water. The riverbed is cracked into plates, and the Jing beyond it is dry too. Three years of drought: there is no telling which river runs clear and which muddy.

recap.zh: 出了斜谷，渭水与泾水都干了；旱了三年，分不出清浊。
recap.en: Out of the Xie valley, the Wei and the Jing were both dry after three years of drought; there was no telling clear from muddy.

text.zh: 泾以渭浊……现在两条都没有水了。鼎的气在这一带，被什么喝干了。
text.en: The Jing is muddied by the Wei, the old song says… Now neither has water. The cauldron's breath is somewhere here, and something has drunk it dry.

alone.zh: 泾以渭浊——如今两条都没有水。鼎的气在这一带，被什么喝干了。
alone.en: The Jing muddied by the Wei, says the song; now neither has water. The cauldron's breath is somewhere here, drunk dry by something.

text.zh: 路边的老农说：雍城在求雨，城里的老人天天在祠前跪着。
text.en: An old farmer by the road says: Yongcheng is praying for rain; the old men kneel before the shrine every day.

exits.means: goes to the city, to Yongcheng, to read the notice

text.zh: 你沿着干河床往西走。雍城的城墙是夯土的，城门上挂着一张告示，风一吹，沙沙地响。
text.en: West along the dry bed. Yongcheng's walls are rammed earth, and a notice rustles on the gate in the wind.

exits.means: looks at the dry riverbed, searches it

text.zh: 河床的裂缝里卡着一片青铜，上面铸着半个"雍"字。
text.en: Wedged in a crack of the riverbed is a shard of bronze, half the character for Yong cast on it.

text.zh: 是从鼎上掉下来的？……不，是从拉鼎的车上。
text.en: From the cauldron? …No — from the cart that hauled it.

alone.zh: 像是从一辆运重物的铜车上掉下来的。
alone.en: It looks to have come off a bronze-fitted cart that carried something heavy.

exits.means: digs in the riverbed for water

text.en: You dig three feet: dry sand all the way.

text.zh: 水不在地下。去雍城问问。
text.en: The water isn't underground. Ask in Yongcheng.

alone.zh: 水不在地下。雍城在西边。
alone.en: The water is not underground. Yongcheng lies west.
